description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ModelTreeAction' and several nested classes representing different types of actions within a tree model, such as entity queries, scripts, and services, used in the OFBiz framework for widget modeling. It includes methods for parsing XML elements into actionable objects and executing those actions within a given context.

classes.name: EntityAnd
classes.description: Represents an '<entity-and>' element that performs a combined entity query using entity finder logic and stores the result in a list iterator for further processing.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents an '<entity-condition>' element that performs an entity query based on specified conditions, storing results similarly to EntityAnd.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: Represents a '<script>' element that executes a script located at a specified source, supporting both XML-based scripts and other types.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a '<service>' element which invokes a designated service with an optional auto-mapping of fields and processes the results accordingly.

methods.name: readNodeActions
methods.description: Parses child XML elements of an actions container into a list of ModelAction instances, recognizing service, script, and other types.

methods.name: readSubNodeActions
methods.description: Similar to readNodeActions, but for sub-node actions, recognizing additional types like entity-and and entity-condition.
